newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Kepphil Shipyard eyes automation venture.
newsitem.headline: Kepphil Shipyard eyes automation venture.

text.p: Kepphil Shipyard Inc said on Friday its board of directors had approved a resolution allowing it to form an automation company with Keppel Automation Pte Ltd of Singapore.

Vice president Kevin Chee told the Philippine Stock Exchange that Kepphil, a member of Keppel Group of Singapore, would invest up 2.703 million pesos as its contribution to the initial paid-in capital of the joint venture.
Chee said the new company will manufacture and service radar equipment and other navigation aids for ships, and automated control systems for buildings and mass transport systems.
Keppel Automation will take up the rest of the equity stake.
